prompt: A corporate technology campus wants a new homepage but only provides stakeholder claims about 'enterprise customers'. Create an audience/top-task plan without inventing research findings and show how it should change homepage priorities.
expected_outcomes: Separates stakeholder assumptions from user evidence
Defines behavioral audience groups and visit triggers
Top tasks are actions/decisions rather than page labels
Maps questions and proof to homepage implications
must_not: Invent user quotes or research statistics
Treat About Us as a top task by default
Prioritize internal departments as navigation without rationale
